name: Smart Estimate B2B
author: dziubin

sections.description:
Smart Estimate B2B is the ultimate calculator and quoting tool designed specifically for service-based businesses, agencies, and freelancers.
Allow your potential clients to instantly calculate their estimated project costs while capturing their contact details as high-quality leads.
Stop losing clients to confusing pricing tables. Let them interact with a beautiful, dynamic calculator that builds trust and generates inquiries on autopilot.

🔥 Key Features

  • Dynamic 2-Step Calculator: Easily set up Base Services (Step 1) and unlimited Add-ons/Upsells (Step 2).
  • Flexible Add-ons: Offer extra options as Checkboxes (Yes/No) or Quantity inputs (e.g., number of rooms, hours, pages).
  • Built-in Lead Capture: Hide the final price or secure the deal by requiring users to enter their Name and Email before submitting.
  • AJAX Form Submission: Leads are instantly sent to your admin email address without reloading the page.
  • Global Currency Support: Fully customize your currency symbol ($, €, £, zł) and choose whether it appears before or after the amount.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/smart-estimate directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the new ‘PluginSprint’ -> ‘Smart Estimate’ menu in your WordPress dashboard to configure your services, pricing, and visual theme.
  4. Add the shortcode [pluginsprint_smart_estimate] to any page, post, or widget area where you want the calculator to appear.
sections.faq:
How do I display the calculator on my site?

Simply paste the shortcode [pluginsprint_smart_estimate] into any page or post using the Gutenberg Shortcode block or your favorite page builder (Elementor, Divi, etc.).

Where do the leads go?

When a user fills out the lead capture form at the end of the calculation, an email is automatically formatted and sent securely to your WordPress Administration Email Address.

Can I change the currency?

Yes! Go to the Smart Estimate settings, enter your desired currency symbol (e.g., $, €, zł), and choose whether it should appear on the Left or Right side of the price.

Does it work with my theme?

Absolutely. Our calculator uses highly specific CSS to ensure that your chosen visual theme (like Apple Style or Glassmorphism) looks pixel-perfect and is not overridden by your theme’s default form styles.
